name: Inverse Linear Interpolation
aliases: Inverse Linear Interpolation for Isosurface Location
definition: Calculates the non-integer position $x$ corresponding to a specific value $v$ between two known values $v_1$ and $v_2$ at positions $x_1$ and $x_2$. Used for finding iso-surface intersections or specific density levels.
summary: Inverse Linear Interpolation calculates the exact position along a grid segment where a scalar field equals a specific isosurface value, distinguishing itself from forward interpolation by solving for location rather than estimating a value.
